source: our own runs of each method's unmodified author release
why: Methods published after MMSA stopped adding models have no third-party reference. Running the authors' own code on our data, our seeds and our machine is the only way to tell an implementation gap from a protocol gap.
how: scripts/author_reference.py run <method> <seeds>, then collect. Nothing inside a release is edited; the only adjustment is the dataset path, applied through the release's own config file.

dpdf_lq.paper: Dual-Path Dynamic Fusion with Learnable Query, EMNLP 2025
